parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, no documented border or facility restriction, and anti-discrimination law (2020/2021) put the paper position above criminalising states. But the dossier documents the practice gap: a 2024 shadow report finds persistent unremedied discrimination against LGBTQI+ people, and a June 2024 case shows police attacking, injuring, arbitrarily detaining and degrading a trans woman — state-perpetrated hostility with only an investigation, no established remedy. No legal gender recognition route exists (resident-facing, light weight for a visitor). Social climate is mixed: Catholic conservatism, hostile media framing, 2017 poll at 49% supporting gender change. No documented universal-exposure measure (tier 1 absent), no organised targeting pattern, but documented state mistreatment plus thin effective recourse and no demonstrated working protection place this in Elevated Risk — above the anchors with universal exclusions, below those with verified remedies.
